cardOverview.overviewText: A business card designed for enterprises with large spends, offering milestone rewards, business privileges, and global acceptance.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 20% discount on partner restaurants via Dineout when using your HDFC Bank Credit Card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Pay via Dineout using your HDFC Credit Card.

benefitRows.name: SMARTBUY
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the HDFC SmartBuy portal using your registered account. Browse through the available deals, select your desired product or service, and apply your HDFC Giga Business credit card at checkout to enjoy a 10% discount. For assistance, contact HDFC business banking support at 1800 267 4333.
